# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a heavy, stout girl. She has a habit of making spiteful grins and disdainful remarks about others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046)_

## Personality

Flossie is dishonest, caustic-tongued, and frequently behaves in a spiteful or adversarial manner toward her peers. She possesses little creative imagination and is prone to boasting, arrogant displays, and expressing contempt for others. Despite her harsh demeanor, she possesses an innate talent for physical tasks like walking wooden fences, and she is capable of feeling fear or regret when a dangerous dare goes wrong.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Goals

- to gain an education at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended school in Brierley, where she was known for being dishonest during lessons, such as peeking at her book during a spelling class. She frequently clashed with Nell Harcourt and other classmates, taking spiteful pleasure in Nell's disciplinary troubles. At a party hosted by Isolde Pembroke, Flossie successfully walked a wooden fence on a dare and challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof; when Nell fell and was injured, Flossie experienced deep fear over the consequences. She later entered the Regent's class under Miss Thorne and attended Regent's Academy in town, though she chose not to pursue the First Class license or the Avery scholarship. After passing the Entrance exams by a narrow margin, she decided to return to Regent's Academy for a second year rather than teach immediately.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013)_

## Quotes

> I don’t believe anyone could walk a ridgepole. At any rate, you couldn’t.  <sub>[v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)</sub>

> In that case, I challenge you to manage it. I challenge you to scale that spot and balance across the ridgepole belonging to the kitchen roof of Mr. Pembroke.  <sub>[v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>

> I’m not really going to teach. I’m just going for an education. My father can afford to send me.  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

> I’m not going to be homesick, I can tell you. City life is a lot better than that slow old Brierley.  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
